summary: Steep narrow private-looking lane, houses within metres and no room to stop.
reasons: Dwellings 1-7 m along most of it

best_section.where: lower start of the lane beside the bush edge

drivers.seclusion: Steep bush on the north side, but houses sit within 6 m past 30 m and a house stands just south of the start.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow paved lane between houses; no verge or pull-off, tight and steep.
drivers.convention: No parked vehicles on the lane other than a car in a driveway at the far end.

flags: Low-lying at start: 7.5 m, Witton Creek 26 m
sun_shade: Mixed: bush canopy over the first 30 m, open sun from the west at the top.
